lesson: When querying FINANCE_PROD.AGGREGATIONS.ARR_LINE_CATEGORIES interactively, ALWAYS filter on as_was_date AND fiscal_quarter_name AND ideally account_id or agreement_id. A naked SELECT * limit 10 still scans the full 724 GB. Use the cluster key: as_was_date.

Snowflake session check: snowflake_query MCP tool errors with 'session does not have a current database' if the query references information_schema without a database qualifier. Use SHOW DATABASES, or fully-qualify: SELECT ... FROM <DB>.information_schema.<view>.

Sourcing ~/.zshrc from bash with `set -euo pipefail` can abort the script (zsh-only syntax). Instead extract only needed vars via a zsh subshell: zsh -c 'source ~/.zshrc; for v in JIRA_API_TOKEN ...; do printf "export %s=%q\n" "$v" "${(P)v}"; done' then eval it in bash.
evidence: ae-ship-pr / ae-do-ticket cred-load block; bash -x showed source ~/.zshrc as last line before silent exit 1.
